# Jorge Froilan Gimenez Perez

> Software Engineer at Apple. Personal CV for Jorge Froilan Gimenez Perez, a systems-oriented software engineer based in Madrid, Spain. Canonical site: https://gimenezp.dev

Jorge Froilan Gimenez Perez is a 27-year-old Software Engineer focused on backend and AI at Apple. He is based in Madrid, Spain, and previously spent around 5 years working in Seoul, South Korea. He holds Spanish nationality and a Korean F6 visa (no sponsorship required).

- Email: jorge@gimenezp.dev
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jfgp
- CV PDF: https://gimenezp.dev/assets/JorgeFroilanGimenezPerez_CV.pdf

He designs and builds production systems end to end, from architecture through delivery, with backend services and infrastructure at the center. Over more than 7 years that has included distributed systems, data pipelines, Kubernetes and cloud platforms, and AI in production: internal AI agents and MCP tooling, knowledge bases and retrieval systems (RAG) sold to thousands of companies in South Korea, generative AI systems, and an LLM chatbot.

## Work experience

- Software Engineer at Apple — November 2025 to present — Madrid, Spain. Architected data analysis applications and high-throughput distributed data pipelines for executive decision-making on large-scale datasets. Designed and deployed internal AI agents and MCP tooling into cross-team operational workflows. Improved the software infrastructure behind those systems, and with it the processing efficiency and performance of core applications. Stack: Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, MCP, SvelteKit, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-apple
- Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Generative AI Team at PwC — September 2023 to November 2025 — Seoul, South Korea. Designed and built production knowledge bases and retrieval systems (RAG) sold to thousands of companies in South Korea, using Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, React, Svelte/SvelteKit, gRPC, RabbitMQ, NATS, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, and Kubernetes. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-pwc
- Cloud Native Developer at Hospital Clínic de Barcelona — September 2020 to November 2025 — Barcelona, Spain and remote. Led design and delivery of clinical applications used by hundreds of medical professionals, including secure backends for sensitive patient data with custom encryption, anonymization, and authentication. Stack: Python, Go, React, Svelte, Next.js, SvelteKit, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Terraform, AWS. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-clinic
- 3D Web Apps Engineer and Backend Engineer at Funnyworks — April 2023 to September 2023 — Seoul, South Korea. Web3 integrations, WebGL interfaces, multiplayer game systems, and a production LLM chatbot on Discord. Stack: TypeScript, Go, React, Three.js, React Three Fiber, AWS. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-funnyworks
- Fullstack Engineer and Engineering Team Leader at Onoma AI — April 2022 to April 2023 — Seoul, South Korea. Directed an engineering team building AI-powered design tools on serverless infrastructure and generative models, including vector databases and API pipelines. Stack: TypeScript, Go, gRPC, Next.js, React, SQL, AWS. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-onoma
- Fullstack Software Engineer at ASDT Systems EU — January 2020 to January 2023 — Manresa, Spain and remote. Architected a scalable real-time drone detection and neutralization web platform with optimized data models and WebSocket servers, and moved legacy applications onto web architectures. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, Go. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-asdt
- R&D Solutions Engineer at The Forest Next — January 2019 to January 2020 — Terrassa, Spain. Machine learning for anomaly detection and predictive maintenance on automotive production lines, collaborative robotics (Universal Robots), and a mobile workforce management application. Stack: Python, Matlab, Flutter, SQL. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-theforest
- Junior Data Analyst at PocketBI Cloud — January 2018 to January 2019 — Barcelona, Spain. Enterprise dashboards in Tableau, Qlik, and PowerBI, plus Python ETL from SQL, NoSQL, and raw sources. Stack: SQL, Python, PowerBI, Tableau. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-pocketbi

## Academic background

- Exchange student, Bachelor's in Computer Science, 고려대학교 (Korea University), Seoul, South Korea — 2021–2022. Two semesters, focused on AI for natural language processing, machine learning applied to graphs, and 3D graphics. https://gimenezp.dev/#academic-ku
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona, Bellaterra, Spain — 2018–2021. 240 ECTS (4-year program), specialization in Computing, with focus on algorithms, performance, operating systems, computer architecture, AI, and scientific computation. Final project: a neural hash system to detect manipulated images. https://gimenezp.dev/#academic-uab
